fields.Appearance: Neatly robed with well-used prayer beads and a calm, attentive expression.
fields.Backstory: A village priest took responsibility for a neglected shrine after its former keeper disappeared.
fields.Goals: Protect the local community, restore the shrine, and learn what happened to the previous priest.

fields.Appearance: Simply dressed, close-cropped, and marked by calluses from both labor and ritual practice.
fields.Backstory: A monastery raised them from childhood and recently sent them beyond its walls for the first time.
fields.Goals: Put their teachings into practice and decide which traditions deserve to survive.

fields.Appearance: Wears practical temple clothes beneath a bright ceremonial sash patched many times.
fields.Backstory: A temple servant secretly kept the sanctuary operating while its clergy became entangled in politics.
fields.Goals: Keep the sanctuary open to ordinary people and expose the misuse of its offerings.

fields.Appearance: Dusty from travel, carrying inexpensive tokens from many shrines and a carefully wrapped relic.
fields.Backstory: A pilgrim promised to cross the realm after surviving an illness no healer expected them to overcome.
fields.Goals: Complete the pilgrimage, repay acts of kindness, and discover whether the recovery was truly miraculous.

fields.Appearance: Severe but approachable, with annotated scriptures tucked into every available pocket.
fields.Backstory: A respected theologian was censured for arguing that an old commandment had been deliberately mistranslated.
fields.Goals: Find the earliest surviving text and reform the faith without dividing its followers.
